findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, Second Reading (Senate vote RCS 693, 28 to 13, passed)
findings.note: Senate Second Reading vote on HB 958, Election Law Changes. The bill text (ratified version) requires a county board to process a registration application only if it affirmatively states the applicant is a United States citizen, with a sworn citizenship statement when the question is left blank. It also sets a process to remove from the rolls voters flagged as possible non-citizens from a federal database and requires removal of deceased voters. Mohammed's recorded vote on the member vote page is No.
subjects: proof of citizenship to register
